verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email provider, so splitting an inbox into prioritized streams is a fair question. The evidence shows no categorized or split-inbox feature that sorts mail into important, team, newsletter or calendar streams. Labels (string tags an agent or developer attaches), allow/block Lists, and creating multiple inboxes are building blocks or adjacent features. They are not the product's own priority-stream triage capability, so they earn no credit here.
